hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Register and configure a new hospital entity in the system, including metadata registration and hospital-specific operational settings configuration.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to register a new hospital entity with required metadata. llg_002 adds the capability to configure hospital-specific settings such as contact info, operating hours, and departmental structure. Together, they form a complete scope for onboarding a hospital into the system with both registration and configuration capabilities.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Manager to monitor real-time operational performance and export historical operational data for analysis and compliance.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Hospital Manager to view real-time operational metrics including patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization, which supports live monitoring. llg_002 enables the Hospital Manager to export historical operational data for analysis and compliance, which supports retrospective review and audit readiness. Together, they cover both real-time monitoring and historical data export without any inferred or generalized functionality.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in, including identity verification, status updates, and resource assignment, which is a distinct operational phase from registration or documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in workflow — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking, and product approval decisions.
hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 enables initiation of inventory replenishment requests; llg_002 enables real-time tracking and status updates of blood samples including expiration and usage; llg_003 enables decision-making on product requests based on availability and clinical need. These capabilities together form a complete scope of inventory lifecycle management by Logistics Staff, including initiation, tracking, and approval actions.

replacement_request.rationale: The original goal should be corrected to reflect the documented outcome of registering and configuring hospitals.
replacement_request.generation_project_description:
Gestao Hospital is a hospital management system that supports the administration of hospitals, patients, beds, products, and blood bank resources. The system allows administrators and hospital managers to register, update, delete, and monitor hospitals, while healthcare staff can manage operational information related to patients, appointments, products, and medical resources.

Patients can use the system to search for hospitals, obtain information about specific hospitals, and receive recommendations about the nearest hospital. Hospital staff can register patients, consult patient information and medical history, manage check-in related information, and maintain notes about treatments.

The system also supports hospital logistics by allowing authorized staff to manage products, quantities, requests, and blood samples. Its overall goal is to centralize hospital administration and improve the coordination of clinical and logistical activities.
